_comment: Shared parity fixtures for the tier-block yaml parser, which is implemented independently in lib/src/config/runtime_tier_cap.dart (parseSaropaTierFromPluginBlock) and extension/src/config/tierConfig.ts (parseTierFromPluginBlock). Both test suites load this file and assert the same expected tier for the same yaml input, so the two implementations cannot silently drift without a test failure on one side.

cases.name: sibling plugin block does not match
cases.yaml:
plugins:
  other_plugin:
    runtime_tier: pedantic
  saropa_lints:
    diagnostics: {}
